name: Shimizu Ayaka
source:
The fashionable leader of the class who seems to be experienced in love and often gives advice on romance to others, but in reality Ayaka is a virgin. Also [url=/c81785]Kotoha's[/url] childhood friend.

The hypnosis skill she is good at is "Aural"; is oriented to the sense of hearing
